prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Select the companion personality and appearance that best fits your daily screen routine.", "Choose Companion"]
1: ["Find Your Ideal Desktop Buddy", "Select your daily screen routine to match with a pet companion tailored to your habits.", "Select Work Style"]
2: ["Upload Pet Reference Photos", "Provide 1 to 3 clear photos to build your custom desktop companion accurately.", "Select Photos"]
3: ["Customize Pet Demeanor", "Choose whether your desktop pet is active, calm, or playful during your workday.", "Select Trait"]
4: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Companion", "Your virtual friend lives right on your desktop to keep you relaxed and focused."]
5: ["How Would You Like Your Pet to Help You Today?", "Choose a companion mode designed for deep focus work, relaxing breaks, or gentle reminders."]
6: ["Includes bonus starter items for your desktop companion!", "Official Adoption Verified + Companion Perk Unlocked"]
7: ["Pick Your Companion in One Click", "Ready instantly. Choose your pet now and meet them on your desktop in seconds.", "Adopt Instantly"]
8: ["Your Companion Adoption Certificate", "Review your pet details and confirm adoption to welcome them to your desktop."]
9: ["Meet Your Screen Companion for Focus and Calm", "A friendly desktop pet that hangs out on your screen, cheers you on, and keeps work stress low.", "Begin Companion Setup"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions bonus starter items and perks.
